You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make a cupcake stand from styrofoam, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply second coat of white primer to all discs (45 minutes)
Step 2. Measure the diameter of the central support pillars (10 minutes)
Step 3. Sketch the decorative scrollwork patterns (30 minutes)
Step 4. Seal the finished stand with a clear protective spray (2 hours)
Step 5. Purchase decorative ribbon for the edges (1 hour)
Step 6. Cut the largest bottom tier disc (15 minutes)
Step 7. Sand the edges of the largest tier until smooth (20 minutes)
Step 8. Buy a pack of heavy-duty toothpicks for internal bracing (30 minutes)
Step 9. Mark the exact center point on the medium tier (5 minutes)
Step 10. Clear a large flat workspace in the garage (20 minutes)
Step 11. Research various cupcake stand designs online (2 hours)
Step 12. Sharpen the styrofoam cutting blades (5 minutes)
Step 13. Cut the medium tier disc (12 minutes)
Step 14. Inventory all required crafting supplies (15 minutes)
Step 15. Mix the adhesive paste for the base (10 minutes)
Step 16. Trace the template for the top tier (10 minutes)
Step 17. Glue the central pillar to the bottom tier (30 minutes)
Step 18. Measure the height of the cupcakes to determine tier spacing (10 minutes)
Step 19. Sketch the layout for the support columns (20 minutes)
Step 20. Select the thickness of the styrofoam sheets (15 minutes)
Step 21. Attach the medium tier to the first pillar (25 minutes)
Step 22. Trim the toothpicks to the correct length (15 minutes)
Step 23. Paint the edges of the tiers with accent colors (1 hour)
Step 24. Clean the styrofoam sheets to remove dust (10 minutes)
Step 25. Let the primary structural glue set (4 hours)
Step 26. Insert toothpick braces into the joints (20 minutes)
Step 27. Cut the top tier disc (10 minutes)
Step 28. Purchase a high-density styrofoam block (1 hour)
Step 29. Print out circular templates for three tiers (15 minutes)
Step 30. Watch a tutorial on cutting styrofoam without fraying (20 minutes)
Step 31. Apply a base coat of gesso to all surfaces (1 hour)
Step 32. Level the medium tier using a spirit level (5 minutes)
Step 33. Draft the placement of the cupcakes on the tiers (30 minutes)
Step 34. Measure the verticality of the center rod (5 minutes)
Step 35. Gather a compass and a protractor (5 minutes)
Step 36. Buff the painted surfaces for a matte finish (30 minutes)
Step 37. Unpack the hot wire foam cutter (5 minutes)
Step 38. Prepare the glitter for the tier borders (20 minutes)
Step 39. Apply a thin layer of wood filler to any gaps (40 minutes)
Step 40. Sand the filler until flush with the foam (30 minutes)
Step 41. Sort the decorative beads by size (20 minutes)
Step 42. Cut the cylindrical pillars from the foam block (40 minutes)
Step 43. Design the custom topper for the stand (1 hour)
Step 44. Glue the ribbon around the edge of the bottom tier (45 minutes)
Step 45. Mark the center point of the bottom tier (5 minutes)
Step 46. Apply glue to the top of the first pillar (10 minutes)
Step 47. Calibrate the foam cutting wire temperature (10 minutes)
Step 48. Cut the foam into manageable square sections (25 minutes)
Step 49. Wipe down the templates to ensure clean lines (5 minutes)
Step 50. Allow the gesso to dry completely (3 hours)
Step 51. Paint the support pillars (50 minutes)
Step 52. Measure the weight capacity of the bottom tier (15 minutes)
Step 53. Buy extra foam in case of mistakes (45 minutes)
Step 54. Attach the ribbon to the medium tier (45 minutes)
Step 55. Reinforce the base with a hidden weight (30 minutes)
Step 56. Organize the craft room (2 hours)
Step 57. Cut the smallest tier disc (10 minutes)
Step 58. Allow the final assembly glue to cure (6 hours)
Step 59. Mix a custom shade of pink paint (15 minutes)
Step 60. Sand the smallest tier edges (15 minutes)
Step 61. Apply a sealant to the ribbon to prevent fraying (30 minutes)
Step 62. Position the second pillar on the medium tier (15 minutes)
Step 63. Bevel the edges of the top tier (25 minutes)
Step 64. Create a pilot hole through the center of the tiers (20 minutes)
Step 65. Apply decorative stones to the pillars (1 hour)
Step 66. Inspect the stand for stability (15 minutes)
Step 67. Test the heat of the glue gun (5 minutes)
Step 68. Paint the top tier disc (40 minutes)
Step 69. Smooth the surface of the pillars with fine sandpaper (25 minutes)
Step 70. Cut out the template for the decorative base (20 minutes)
Step 71. Wrap the base tier in decorative paper (50 minutes)
Step 72. Apply a second layer of sealant (1 hour)
Step 73. Glue the ribbon to the top tier (30 minutes)
Step 74. Sand the support pillars (20 minutes)
Step 75. Clean the workspace of foam beads (30 minutes)
Step 76. Double-check the alignment of all three tiers (10 minutes)
Step 77. Check the expiration date of the glue (5 minutes)
Step 78. Find a pencil and a long ruler (5 minutes)
Step 79. Secure the central dowel through all tiers (40 minutes)
Step 80. Wipe away excess glue with a damp cloth (15 minutes)
Step 81. Measure the height of the top pillar (5 minutes)
Step 82. Glue the decorative topper in place (20 minutes)
Step 83. Plug in the task lighting (2 minutes)
Step 84. Clean the paintbrushes (15 minutes)
Step 85. Apply the final decorative glitter (45 minutes)
Step 86. Read the instruction manual for the foam cutter (30 minutes)
Step 87. Mark the center of the top tier (5 minutes)
Step 88. Cut the ribbon into three specific lengths (10 minutes)
Step 89. Select the color palette for the stand (20 minutes)
Step 90. Lay out the drop cloth to catch debris (10 minutes)
Step 91. Prepare a bowl of soapy water for cleanup (5 minutes)
Step 92. Check the batteries in the digital scale (2 minutes)
Step 93. Let the primer dry overnight (12 hours)
Step 94. Glue the top tier to the second pillar (30 minutes)
Step 95. Sketch the cutting lines on the foam sheets (25 minutes)
Step 96. Apply a first coat of white primer (1 hour)
Step 97. Sharpen the compass lead (2 minutes)
Step 98. Glue the top tier to the structure (30 minutes)
Step 99. Verify the tier levels one last time (10 minutes)
Step 100. Take a photo of the finished cupcake stand (5 minutes)
